chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Aḥmad ibn ʿUmar, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, “Why was Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام named by this title?”
He said, “Because he supplies them with knowledge.”
Have you not heard in the Book of Allah: “and we bring provisions for our family”?
And in another narration, he said, “Because the provision of the believers comes from him; he supplies them with knowledge.”

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful; the title being explained in the narration
key_terms.الْعِلْمَ: knowledge; the provision given to the believers in this hadith
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: the Book of Allah, meaning the Qur'an
key_terms.يَمِيرُهُمُ: He provides for them or supplies them

ai.seo_question: Why is Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام called Amīr al-Muʾminīn?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the title Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام by linking it to the meaning of providing sustenance, here understood as the sustenance of knowledge. It also invokes a Qur'anic expression to show the linguistic basis of the title and emphasizes the Imam’s role as the source of the believers’ intellectual and spiritual nourishment.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin Umar who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Why was Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> named as such?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Because he<sup>asws</sup> brings them (يَمِيرُهُمْ) the knowledge.
Have you nor heard in the Book of Allahazwj [12:65] and we will bring (نَمِيرُ) grain for our family’.
And in another report, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Because he<sup>asws</sup> nourished the Momineen from his<sup>asws</sup> own presence, feeding them the knowledge’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘Umar who has said the following.
“I asked abu al-Hassan (a.s.), ‘Why is he (Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) called Amir al-Mu’minin (commander of the faithful)?”
He said, “Because he fed them knowledge.
Have you not read in the Holy Quran, “We can buy more provisions with this for our family. .” [12:65]”
In another hadith it is said, “Because Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) would feed them knowledge.”
